label: loose issue
definition: An open issue that is not a pull request, not an effort, not a sub-issue, carries no relation line (Depends on, Blocks, Extends, Parallel-safe with, Sub-issue of, Blocked by #N) and is not on the board with Status = Backlog: work with no home. cckit doctor --loose counts and lists them; --ratchet fails when the count rises above lib/core/loose-issues.baseline, and the captain runs it when it closes a wave.
is_not: A backlog item: a backlog item sits on the board in Backlog; a loose issue sits nowhere.
An impediment: a loose issue stops nothing by itself; it is unfiled work.
A stale issue: a stale issue has a home and no recent activity; a loose issue has no home.
